description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, setting up the main user interface during activity creation. It handles theme setting and layout selection with a fallback.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity class that sets up the application's main UI with a specific theme and layout, including a fallback layout if the primary one is missing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the theme, and determines which layout to display based on resource availability.
